SELECT 
  AVG(invoice_mean_price) as avg_of_mean_prices,
  AVG(line_item_count) as avg_line_items_per_invoice
FROM (
  SELECT 
    i.invoice_number,
    AVG(ili.product_price) as invoice_mean_price,
    COUNT(ili.invoice_number) as line_item_count
  FROM Invoices i
  LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number
  GROUP BY i.invoice_number
)
